'''Darth Vader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]].

Title

ダース・ベイダー

Card Text

戦闘の際、各戦闘運命数を＋1できる（合計に＋1ではなく、1回引くごとに＋1できる）。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋3となる。「ベイダー専用タイ・ファイター」に乗っているなら、戦闘力＋4、回避値＋3となる。耐：損耗＜5。

Lore

''シスの暗黒卿。皇帝の僕。サイバネティック生命維持装置を内蔵した装甲服に身を包む。オビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子であった。銀河一のパイロットであり、狡猾な戦士でもある。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Darth Vader. '''Lore:''' Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of the Emperor. Clad in armor containing a cybernetic life-support system. Was a pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi. The best pilot in the galaxy and also a cunning warrior. '''Game text:''' During battle, you may add 1 to each battle destiny number (not 1 to the total, but 1 for each draw). A starship he pilots has power +3. If aboard Vader's Custom TIE, it has power +4 and maneuver +3. Immune to attrition < 5. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text explicitly explains that the bonus applies to each draw rather than the total; the English printed text says it adds 1 to each battle destiny. The Japanese uses 'pilot' where the English lore says 'starpilot.' The conditional wording also says he may add the bonus.

Notes

'''Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Darth Vader]], released by [[Decipher]] as a case topper for [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. Its checklist rarity is P.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive]. Each case of six Reflections II booster boxes included one Japanese Darth Vader foil as a case topper. Each box also included one randomly selected foil box topper: [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]], [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]], [[Leia With Blaster Rifle]] or [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]].[https://store.starwarsccg.org/product/reflections-2-complete-foil-set-105-foils/ Reflections 2 Complete Foil Set], Star Wars CCG Players Committee Store. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210412121344/https://store.starwarsccg.org/product/reflections-2-complete-foil-set-105-foils/ Internet Archive].

'''Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

助けて下さい、オビ＝ワン・ケノービ

Card Text

どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の支配する位置にオビ＝ワンがいる時に使う。このターンの間、オビ＝ワンの能力値を好きなだけ減らし、減らした分を、任意のロケーションでの戦闘の合計能力値に足せる。2：戦闘が起こった際、隣接した位置に反乱軍がいれば、1名選んで、リアクションとして戦闘が始まった位置に移動できる。

Lore

''レイアは要請をホログラムに託した。「ケノービ将軍、かつてクローン大戦の際、あなたは我が父に仕えてくださいました。帝国軍と戦うため、再びあなたの力が必要なのです。」''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Help me, Obi-Wan Kenobi. '''Lore:''' Leia entrusted her request to a hologram. ‘General Kenobi, during the Clone Wars you served my father. To fight the Imperial forces, your help is needed again.’ '''Game text:''' Choose one. 1: Use when Obi-Wan is at a location you control. For this turn, you may reduce Obi-Wan's ability by any amount and add the amount reduced to the total ability in battle at any location. 2: When a battle occurs, if a Rebel is at an adjacent location, choose one and move that person as a reaction to the location where the battle began. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English lore says Leia's father asks Kenobi for help in his struggle; the Japanese says help is needed again to fight the Imperial forces. The English game text refers to a site you control, applying ability toward drawing battle destiny at another location, and ability used this way not being usable again that turn. The Japanese text instead refers to a controlled location, adding the reduction to total ability in battle at any location, and does not state the same restriction. The English second option specifies an adjacent battle site; the Japanese uses location.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p.41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

He's a tough customer weighing in at 3 power and 3 ability! His deploy is 3, which isn't cheap.... unless you have two Imperial starships on the table, then he is just a mere 1 Force to deploy anywhere! Another wonderful aspect of this versitile card is [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] is both a warrior and a pilot, so no matter what type of deck you play him in he is a formitable enemy for those pesky Rebels. Combos: [[Admiral Motti]] + [[Lone Pilot]] - This is a great combo to use in your space decks. This simply allows you to add to battle destiny if [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] is defending a battle alone at a system. So put him on [[Black 2]] or a [[TIE Avenger]] and sit back and smile as you opponent initiates a battle. You drop down [[Lone Pilot]] and whammo, you get 2 battle destiny.....then hope you get a lucky draw! [[Admiral Motti]] + [[Vader's Eye]] + [[Lone Warrior]] - If you choose to deploy [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] to a site, use these two Lost Interrupts to insure you don't get squashed by the Rebellion. If [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] is defending a battle alone at a site these two interrupt will allow you to draw 2 battle destiny, to make sure you put some fear into the hearts of the those pesky Rebels. |combos=* [[Admiral Motti]] + [[Lone Pilot]] Add two battle destiny if [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] is defending a battle alone at a system.[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?cardId=60 Scomp Link Access: Admiral Motti (Dark)], scomp.starwarsccg.org.
